models.label: ACE-Step Turbo
models.description: Fast diffusion model. A full song in tens of seconds; can also remix an existing song.

options.label: Vocals
options.help: Vocals can be hit or miss: each run is a new roll, so regenerate if a chorus comes out messy.

choice_help.lyrics: A lead singer. Lyrics are drafted from the image or description and can be edited before generating.
choice_help.chops: Wordless 'aa / oh' vocal layer, kept quiet in the background. Suits atmospheric tracks.

options.label: Lyrics language

choice_help.ja: Japanese, written in romaji. The tested one: gives the Vocaloid feel.
choice_help.en: English: longer, conversational lines that rhyme. Tested on rock and EDM.

locked_choices.ko: Locked until tested. Each language needs its own listening tests -- phrasing, line length and how the melody fits the words all change with it, not just the words.
locked_choices.zh: Locked until tested. Each language needs its own listening tests -- phrasing, line length and how the melody fits the words all change with it, not just the words.

options.help: Japanese and English are tested; Korean and Mandarin unlock once they have been.

options.label: Voice

choice_help.auto: Picked from the genre: male for rock, punk, metal, hip hop, country and blues; female for J-pop, anime and similar; either otherwise.
choice_help.female: The tested voice: a bright, Vocaloid-style female lead.
choice_help.male: A deep male lead. Tested on J-pop; one take in a few may still sit high.
choice_help.duet: Male and female together: he takes the verses, she takes the pre-chorus, both sing the chorus.

options.help: There are no voice models: the voice is described to the model in words, so each run varies a little.

options.label: Vocal tone
options.help: For listening tests: one extra tone word for the singer. None of these is tested yet.

options.label: Song structure
options.help: Describes how the piece should develop instead of sending one flat tag. Vocal songs get their structure from the lyrics.

choice_help.off: The model picks its own shape. On long tracks that usually means a loop with no real intro or ending.
choice_help.full: Intro, theme, build, climax, breakdown, outro. Sections drop automatically if the song is too short.

options.label: Remix strength
options.help: How much of the original song to keep. 0.3-0.5 for a different genre, 0.5-0.7 to restyle it. Capped at 0.7: above that the original's structure dominates and a new style comes out choppy.

options.label: Solver
options.help: The difference is small and shows most on dense electronic material.

choice_help.euler: ACE-Step's default. Steadier levels, but the likelier of the two to crackle on busy, distorted material.
choice_help.heun: Adds a correction step. Fewer crackle artifacts on dense material at no extra time, but showed more abrupt level drops.

options.label: Lock BPM
options.help: 0 = the model picks, and its choice drifts over the song. Set a value to pin the grid. Vocal songs always get a locked tempo: drafting lyrics suggests one here, and 0 picks one from the style. Guide: 70-90 lo-fi, 100-115 hip hop, 120-130 house, 140-150 phonk, 150-175 DnB.

models.label: ACE-Step SFT
models.description: Higher-quality variant: 50 diffusion steps for richer detail. Slower than Turbo.
